flags.description: Extracts entities and relations from observations into a knowledge graph.
flags.enableHow: Set GRAPH_EXTRACTION_ENABLED=true and provide an LLM key, then restart.
flags.label: Knowledge graph extraction

flags.description: Periodically summarizes sessions into semantic facts + procedures.
flags.enableHow: Set CONSOLIDATION_ENABLED=true and provide an LLM key, then restart.
flags.label: Memory consolidation

flags.description: Every observation is compressed by the LLM for richer summaries (costs tokens). OFF uses zero-LLM synthetic compression.
flags.enableHow: Set AGENTMEMORY_AUTO_COMPRESS=true and provide an LLM key.
flags.label: LLM-powered observation compression

flags.description: Hooks write recalled context into Claude Code's conversation. OFF captures in the background without injecting.
flags.label: In-conversation context injection
